summary: Every acceptance criterion V01-V20 maps to delivered work: P1 provider reader and opt-in grant (V07-V09, V20), P2 prd-gated mirror CronJob and script (V01, V04-V06, V10-V12, V14, V16-V18), P3 S3MirrorStale rule (V13), P4 module-level grant (V01, V08), P5 restore runbook and drill (V03, V19), and P6 decision record (V02, V14-V16). Every requirement and ruling in the plan (R1-R6, T1-T3, D1, D2, W1, B2, A1, settled 1-12) is carried by one of those phases, and I checked the load-bearing parts in code: failures without skipping, a vanished bucket left alone, pruning to 30 newest, the gating, the 2 h bound, a read-only PVC mount, the ESO eso/prd/* glob covering the new leaf, and the S3 group reaching the storage release. What remains is live checks, pushes and operator keystrokes (the drill, TF_ACC tests, the dev deploy), which belong to the test phase and close-out, plus minor runbook and record bugs B1-B3 that don't justify a phase. I added close-out S7 (the Argo CD hook env lacks HOMELAB_S3_BACKUP_READER; latent until an S3 release migrates) and A3 (confirm the pre-run crypt key leaf, which can't be checked from the pod); nothing was struck.
